messages:
Sam H. (Partnerships): Quick update 1 ApertureBio (clinical-trials analytics) finished GA onboarding via the Azure Marketplace and toggled their Dedicated reservation today 389
Maya L. (Sales): Nice work team! They moved from a proof-of-concept to a 12-month reserved commit during the call, signed by their Head of Data.
Tomas G. (Solutions Eng): Rolled their model bundle and migrated traffic with zero errors. We shipped the custom batching profile for their heavy short-sequence workload. p50 inference down to ~95ms.
Noah P. (Oncall): Observed a transient spike during the migration (scale-up), auto-scaling handled it. Logged an ops note: incident link internal/ops/INC-2026-0412. No customer-facing impact.
Sam H. (Partnerships): Pilot outcomes: 3.5x throughput vs their legacy infra, estimated monthly savings ~48%, and initial plan to expand to 5 additional teams in Q3. They also agreed to be on our partner case study.
Maya L. (Sales): Customer quote for the case study: "Redwood's Dedicated plan removed our performance bottleneck and cut costs. Onboarding was smooth." I'll paste the signed quote to the drive.
Tomas G. (Solutions Eng): For the record, the small change that helped was moving to continuous KV-prefetch and enabling the short-seq kernel set. Repro snippet I used for load test:
```
# run k6 load test
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 2m scripts/inference-test.js
```
Deploy Bot: deploy/dedicated/aperturebio -> prod succeeded (job: d-77411) 705
Noah P. (Oncall): Added canary rule (10% -> new q4-optim) with auto-fallback if errorRate > 0.4%. Monitoring dashboards: /dashboards/aperturebio-dedicated
Sam H. (Partnerships): Huge thanks to Tomas and Noah for the engineering lift, and Maya for driving the contract. Can someone add a 3-bullet summary I can share at the company sync? @here :tada:
Maya L. (Sales): I'll post a short blurb in #all-hands tomorrow morning.
Tomas G. (Solutions Eng): I'll put a short technical note into #eng-runtime with perf graphs and the kernel config.
Sam H. (Partnerships): Link to draft case study & assets: https://redwood.example/partners/aperturebio-case-draft. Closing loop 1
